question: _____ is the harvest festival of the Kodava community of Coorg.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puttari.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Puttari** is the harvest festival of the people of the Kodava tribes.
 
• It is celebrated in North Malabar rice bracket paddy crop harvest
